admission.justification: Per-document host lookups at click time would leave an empty/blocked pane and multiply host work.

applicability: Preclick discovery of canonical document chats represented by the dashboard tree.
conditions: One batch accepts at most 256 selections and takes one live-agent census.
Known answers can steer immediately and a fresh single-document answer corrects them.
exclusions: Projects/taskless enumeration and unrecorded host agents are not tree documents.

evidence: dashboard/src/cockpit/document-chat/knownChats.test.tsx › "switches with the click to a chat the tree's one request already named, and takes the fresh answer after it"; mcp/tests/test_role_document_chats.py; walk C2 of Attempt3 (the dashboard's requests logged)

statement: The chats of the documents the tree lists are known before a click: one request names up to 256 documents, the host is read once for it, and what that read cannot tell is answered as unknown, never as no chat.
